name: Helios Virtual Cockpit
summary: Builds virtual cockpit panels on touchscreens and extra monitors, driven by DCS exports.
description: Helios lets you lay out gauges, switches and exported displays on secondary or touch screens for DCS aircraft. It is a separate program with its own installer.

authors.name: Helios Virtual Cockpit community (BlueFinBima and contributors)

releases.changelog: Helios 1.6.618: mostly bug fixes, adds AH-6J 1.1 community mod interface, F-16 CMDS patch, memory leak fix.
